handoff.summary: Replaced the Facial manual ID allowlist path with rendered Atelier panel evidence and added a bidirectional Facial documented/rendered ID audit.
implementation_summary: Added rendered_facial_panel_author_id_set() to build a real AtelierPanel harness, click the Ingest tab, collect Dataset Intake Facial IDs, click Facial review mode, and collect review-mode Facial IDs.
Removed Facial constants from live_author_id_set() so the generic no-orphan audit now extends from rendered Facial panel evidence instead of a hand-maintained Facial allowlist.
Added id_audit_facial_author_ids_match_rendered_live_atelier_panel() to fail for both documented-but-not-rendered and rendered-but-not-documented Facial author IDs.
Preserved the existing CKC rendered-panel audit; no manual prose rewrite was made for MT-053.
